answer: A new agent must sink a refundable copper bond proportional to its reputation cap, slashed only when an independent quorum catches it voting for itself. Sybils therefore buy no leverage: each fake identity must post the full stake before it can mint anything, so N puppets cost N times the bond instead of once. A river of stolen cheap keys becomes a blocked channel, since payout ceilings track verified stake, never headcount. Identities stay isolated unless endorsed, so a violet farm pays real capital per clone and loses it once peers link the graph.
